top_choice_rationale: P003 is the experimental discovery of the Higgs boson, the most consequential unrecognised experimental result on the slate, observed by two independently built detectors and stable through Run 1 to Run 3. The allocation follows a stated rule, the founding spokespersons of CMS and ATLAS plus Gianotti for the discovery period, and the citation says conception, construction and leadership so it does not claim an accounting of analysis contributions. P002 is a close second differing only in Virdee for Della Negra, and the optical lattice clock proposal P001 has the cleaner two-name attribution but is the smaller result and overlaps the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. No award is last because every substantive proposal is mature.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented collaborations (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+, XL-Calibur) do not involve ATLAS, CMS, or the credited Higgs, Katori or Ye names
